message.reasoning: We need to answer from policy excerpts. The question: "How do I cut down email notifications to only ones assigned directly to me?" This is about reducing notification email volume. The policy says: Notification email settings are per person, in Profile → Notifications, separate from workspace-wide rules. Each notification type can be turned off independently: assignment, mention, status change, digest. So to get only assignment notifications, leave assignment on and turn others off. Changes take effect immediately. So answer: go to Profile → Notifications, enable assignment notifications, disable mention, status change, digest. Provide steps. Use policy. No mention of instructions. Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"Hi! To receive only the emails for tasks that are assigned to you, go to your Profile → Notifications. There you can toggle each notification type separately. Keep the *Assignment* toggle on and turn off the *Mention*, *Status change*, and *Digest* options. Once you save, the changes take effect immediately and only affect your own account. No admin changes are needed."}

arguments.message: Hi! To receive only the emails for tasks that are assigned to you, go to your Profile → Notifications. There you can toggle each notification type separately. Keep the *Assignment* toggle on and turn off the *Mention*, *Status change*, and *Digest* options. Once you save, the changes take effect immediately and only affect your own account. No admin changes are needed.
